name: Velodrome
notes: Colored: the official brand-kit symbol.svg unchanged (two interlocking rings striped #FF1100, #FDBF41, #F1ECE2 and #007FFF, with the kit's 48% #191919 shadow gradient), placed on the 64 grid

Mono: all ribbon stripes in currentColor, drawn in the colored mark's painting order inside a mask (each path defined once and reused with <use>); each stripe first cuts a knockout seam (a 10-unit black stroke of its outline in the 401-unit source space, about 0.7 units on the grid) into the earlier stripes of a different colour (clip-path), so the stripes stay apart without opacity tiers; the shadow is dropped
